+---
+## What
+Port the codec pair that eventplan.md § "Consolidation of the siblings" names: "the `SchemaConverter` / `GeneratedContentCodec` pair". This is a behavioral port: keep the logic the same, and write new header comments in the `//` block style of `Capabilities/Shell/ShellCapability.swift`.
+
+- Source: `/Users/wballard/github/swissarmyhammer/FoundationModelsMCP/Sources/FoundationModelsMCP/SchemaConverter.swift` (759 lines), `GeneratedContentCodec.swift`, and `Value+ScalarString.swift`.
+- Target: `Sources/FoundationModelsMultitool/Capabilities/MCP/SchemaConverter.swift`, `GeneratedContentCodec.swift`, `Value+ScalarString.swift`.
+- `SchemaIR`, `SchemaConversion`, `SchemaConversionLogRecord`, and `GeneratedContentCodecError` stay as they are. Replace the `swift-log` `Logger` with `os.Logger`, or with the `SchemaConversionLogHandler` closure that the source already has.
+- Keep the types internal, the way the Shell capability does. Tests reach them with `@testable import`.
+- The converter feeds `MCPTool` (a later task): a JSON Schema from `tools/list` becomes a `GenerationSchema` for the verb's arguments, and the codec turns the model's `GeneratedContent` into `[String: MCP.Value]` for `tools/call`.
+
+## Acceptance Criteria
+- [ ] Each JSON Schema shape the source converts gives the same `SchemaIR` here (structure, guides, `$ref` definitions, unsupported keywords logged and dropped).
+- [ ] `GeneratedContentCodec.arguments(from:)` gives the same `[String: Value]` for the same `GeneratedContent`.
+- [ ] `swift build` succeeds.
+
+## Tests
+- [ ] Port `SchemaConverterGuideTests.swift`, `SchemaConverterStructureTests.swift`, and the `GeneratedContentCodec` tests from `/Users/wballard/github/swissarmyhammer/FoundationModelsMCP/Tests/FoundationModelsMCPTests/` into `Tests/FoundationModelsMultitoolTests/`. Port the fixtures they read from `Tests/FoundationModelsMCPTests/Fixtures/` into `Tests/FoundationModelsMultitoolTests/MCPFixtures/` and declare that folder as a `.copy` resource in `Package.swift`, the way `FilesGoldens` is declared.
+- [ ] `swift test --filter SchemaConverter` passes.
+- [ ] `swift test --filter GeneratedContentCodec` passes.
+
+## Workflow
+- Use `/tdd` — port the tests first, then port the code to make them pass. #eventplan #phase-4
\ No newline at end of file

+    - `MCPCapability.swift` header now states that the three codec files are present.
